idea: We run four delivery vans and maintenance records live in a glovebox folder per van. I want the records in one place so services stop getting missed.

problem: One van missed its brake service because the reminder was a sticky note in a different van; repairs cost triple what the service would have.
user: Two drivers who report issues, and me booking the garage work. The garage itself stays on phone and paper.
workflow: Drivers log an issue or mileage when they park up; I check upcoming services weekly and book the garage; completed work gets entered from the invoice.
success: No overdue services across the fleet for a full quarter, and the full history of any van printable when we sell it.
operations: I am the only person who would fix the tool if it breaks, and I am not technical; it has to survive being ignored for weeks.
